text: Pro Honda is Honda Motor Co., Ltd.'s global unified brand of genuine oils and chemical products. Honda announced it as title sponsor of the second Honda LCR entry for the 2026 MotoGP season.
short: Pro Honda is Honda's genuine oil and chemical brand

source.name: Honda Global: <FIM Grand Prix World Championship MotoGP> Sponsorship Agreement Reached with LCR Honda; Full-Season MotoGP Entry as Pro Honda LCR
source.quote: Pro Honda is Honda’s global unified brand of genuine oils and chemical products, developed to maximize the performance of Honda vehicles
